name: onda
description: A fluid identity for a coastal movement studio. Hand-drawn wave geometry, ocean blue, and cloud-white surfaces create a calm but active visual rhythm.
heading: urbanist
rules: Wave strokes retain rounded caps and never taper.
Allow organic bands to flow off both sides of the canvas.
Use sea glass for generous background areas, not paragraph text.

system.concept: Tidal contours, folded wave ribbons, sea-glass translucency, and airy movement typography. The composition alternates still reading areas with broad flowing graphics.
headline: Move with
your own rhythm.
system.productNote: Make a little room for movement.
features: A practice that makes space for your own pace.
Movement, breath, and consistency over perfection.
A calm, thoughtful place to connect with yourself.
system.layoutNote: Foam-white hero with sea-glass tidal art, a wide text-to-image gutter, and shell-colored section annotations. Rounded movement cards are balanced by open space.
